 HUNTSVILLE, Utah (KUTV) — A magnitude 3.4 earthquake struck about 7 miles southeast of Huntsville, according to the U.S. Geological Survey.
 Two people reported feeling light shaking from the earthquake, according to a U.S. Geological Survey map.
 A magnitude 3.4 earthquake struck about 7 miles southeast of Huntsville, according to the U.S. Geological Survey.
